done_witness.finding: The channel-0 witness of the sparse combine followed channel 0's forward warp only; a source that waits for its own channels and channel 0 could write its next dispatch into a forwarder's dispatch scale-out inbox while other forward warps still read the overlapping combine scale-up inbox (found by an independent design review). Fixed: every forward warp releases a rank-local DONE count and channel 0 waits for all C before the witness.
done_witness.fault_injection: Three runs on kermit 4F:20A (FP8, hidden 2048, capacity 2048, 24 SMs, all three switches; GPU suite with a one-small-source case): forward warps of channels 5 mod 8, then of every channel but 0, delayed ~200 us before their reads; mixed then spread routing. The tree without DONE (2d22e5e9 + fault) passed all three, so the gap is argued from the layout and the code, not reproduced. The tree with DONE passed with and without the fault.
